## Checklist

- [ ] `uv run pytest`, `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `mypy` pass
- [ ] New behaviour has a test; a change to the written file also updates or explains the golden files in `tests/golden/`
- [ ] A rule taken from Skatteverket cites its source (URL) in a comment
- [ ] README updated if behaviour changed; a line added to `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] No real personnummer, names, SRU files or trade data in code, tests, docs or the PR text
